verdict.rationale: A state workforce agency could plausibly publish bulk datasets such as wage or labor statistics, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no downloadable datasets, registry extracts or statistics files. It documents only interactive search and locator tools and QuickFile, which uploads employer wage reports to TWC rather than publishing public data, and probes found no machine-readable endpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
